none: PAS NCL-084403: NCL-084403: A copper-alloy stud from a Roman cavalry helmet of the late 2nd/3rd century.
contea di ritrovamento: Northumberland (Inghilterra e Galles)

A ferrous copper-alloy conical study from a Roman helmet, dating to the late 2nd and 3rd centuries. The main body of the stud is somewhat corroded, with the original surface appearing as a cortex covering approximately one third of the stud. The apex/point of the stud is very rounded.
